observations.what: Bosses are external corner cylinders that also bulge 0.207 mm into each cavity corner (0.81 mm3 per corner, base inside box [-1.6,-1.6]-[0,0]). No requirement is broken; it is cosmetic and makes the closed box 84 x 64 rather than about 78 x 58.

Header distances are reported as 5.2 mm, which is the min_gap search cap (clearance + 5.0), not a distance; the true value is >= 5.7 (floor top). Pass/fail agrees and the reported L3 value (1.676, the jacks) is right, so L3.12.2.1 passes; capped values should be marked as lower bounds.
Disagrees with the judge's Pico header-pin residual 0.000 (and with the agent's own grid_conformance check 0.000); it seems to include the exempt PJ-320A terminals or another quantity. Not graded.
